newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French bond futures settled slightly higher after a subdued session where a dearth of investor interest left traders sceptical that there would be any major moves higher before the end of the year.
The March contract fluctuated in a narrow range between 128.40 and 128.60 to settle up 0.12 at 128.46 with only 52,719 lots traded during the day.
March PIBOR settled slightly higher at 96.70, but below the new contract high of 96.72 set following a cut in call money earlier on Wednesday to 3-3/16 5/16 percent.
